items.text: Never have I ever eaten pizza for breakfast.
Never have I ever fallen asleep in a cinema.
Never have I ever sung in the shower so loudly the neighbours heard.
Never have I ever pretended to know a song I'd never heard.
Never have I ever waved back at someone who wasn't waving at me.
Never have I ever walked into a glass door.
Never have I ever sent a text to the wrong person.
Never have I ever laughed at a joke I didn't understand.
Never have I ever cried at an animated film.
Never have I ever forgotten a close friend's birthday.
Never have I ever tripped going up the stairs.
Never have I ever said "you too" when a waiter told me to enjoy my meal.
Never have I ever broken a bone.
Never have I ever been on TV.
Never have I ever ridden a horse.
Never have I ever eaten something that fell on the floor.
Never have I ever talked to a plant.
Never have I ever watched the same series three times.
Never have I ever pretended to be on the phone to avoid someone.
Never have I ever looked for my phone while holding it.
Never have I ever kept a library book far too long.
Never have I ever dyed my hair a wild colour.
Never have I ever won a trophy.
Never have I ever sleepwalked.
Never have I ever finished a whole tub of ice cream in one go.
Never have I ever met a celebrity.
Never have I ever practised an award speech in the mirror.
Never have I ever fallen off a bike.
Never have I ever locked myself out of my house.
Never have I ever worn socks with sandals in public.
Never have I ever built a snowman.
Never have I ever missed a flight.
Never have I ever named my car or my bike.
Never have I ever had a nickname I hated.
Never have I ever been stung by a jellyfish.
Never have I ever stayed up all night to watch the sunrise.
Never have I ever cooked a meal nobody could eat.
Never have I ever taken a selfie with a stranger's dog.
Never have I ever learned a dance from a video.
Never have I ever slept in a tent.
